text: The Song Bench is where reagents become magic. It **empowers** raw reagents, writes them into **songs**, fletches **verse arrows** and **anoints** Spiritgear weapons.
Empowering spends 16 Pulse. A sheet takes 3 to 7 empowered reagents, paper, and one mark of Ritual Chalk.

pages.title: Empowering
text: Place the bench within 8 blocks of a Resonance Totem and a charged generator, and keep a Reagent Pouch on your hotbar: the bench reads its reagents from the pouch.
Click a reagent in the list to select it. **Empower**, or a shift-click, turns one raw reagent into an empowered one for 16 Pulse.

pages.title: Writing a song
text: Seat paper and Ritual Chalk, then pick 3 to 7 empowered reagents in order: select one and press **Add**, or click it twice. The first reagent picks the song's shape; **Voice** picks which nearby totem it sings in.
Press **Write** for a **Song Sheet**. Sing it once straight from your hand, or bind it into a songbook: seat the book, leave the sheet in the output and press **Write** with nothing in the sequence.
With a book seated, **Write** puts the song straight into it. **Lift** takes the open page back out as a sheet, and **Take** hands you raw reagents from the pouch.

pages.title: What it costs
text: Writing spends those reagents, the paper and one chalk mark, plus **12 Pulse** for each reagent on the sheet. A ranked bench asks less Pulse for everything it does.
The first songbook holds 1 page of up to 3 reagents. The bound book holds 3 pages of up to 5, and the chorus book 5 pages of up to 7.
Right-click a held book to sing. Crouch and right-click to turn the page. A Pulse Cell seated in the book pays first, then the cells you carry.

pages.title: Anointing a weapon
text: Beside the output is a **weapon slot**. Put a Spiritgear weapon in it (no vanilla or other mod's weapon takes an anointment), select a reagent in the list and press **Anoint**.

It spends **4 empowered reagents** of that kind and **32 Pulse**, and the weapon keeps the reagent's power until you anoint it with something else. The whole story is on the [Anointing](anointing) page.

steps.caption: A Song Bench with a generator in range.
An Earth totem in range can be the voice of the sheet.
Add a Fire totem and the bench can sing in either voice.

pages.title: Verse arrows
text: Select an empowered reagent and press **Fletch**: one reagent and 8 Pulse make **four** verse arrows, sung in the voice you chose.

For a stronger arrow, lay out up to 3 empowered reagents with **Add** first, then press **Fletch**: the four arrows carry that short verse, for 8 Pulse a reagent. Each copy of the lead reagent adds a point of power, and any other reagent rides along on the hit.
Hold the Pulse Bow and draw. A plain bolt spends up to 6 Pulse, at full draw; a verse arrow adds 6 more and carries its reagent's song. The Pulse Crossbow fires the same arrows.
A Pulse Cell seated in the bow pays first, then the cells you carry.
A redstone signal pauses the bench.

pages.title: The Pulse Bow
text: Forged like the other Spiritgear: two **Manifested Ingots** and a **Bone Chime**, strung with three string. It needs no arrows; each draw throws a sonic bolt that flies straight and fades after about 60 blocks.
A full draw hits for **7**, a part draw for its share, so a quick tap is only a tap. A verse arrow adds a point for each copy of its lead reagent fletched into it, up to **3**.
Each shot wears it a point, out of 1,024. Mend it at the [Spirit Anvil](spirit_anvil) with Manifested Ingots, a quarter each.
